data.name: Small Hero
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to the fantastical arena of Small Hero!
This is a fast-paced, entertaining light Roguelike action survival game. You will play as a lone hero, facing off against waves of monsters. Each round is a brand-new adventure: you must shop and strengthen yourself between waves, then dive into the next, even more intense battle for survival!

Will you become a crit-slashing Berserker or a sharpshooting Gunslinger? Each choice will shape your unique combat style. Survive, scavenge loot, unlock more content, and then... play just one more round!

Key Features

⚡ Fast-Paced Frenzied Combat
Each battle lasts 10-30 minutes, offering tight, action-packed, and immensely satisfying gameplay! Dodge through hordes of monsters and defeat all enemies within the limited time frame, testing your positioning and crowd-control skills.

🎭 Massive Roster, Unique Playstyles
Choose from a variety of beloved heroes, each with their own unique starting weapons, attributes, and playstyles! Whether it's the fist-wielding Boxer, the bullet-spamming Ammunition Expert, or the Mysterious Pirate, there's a hero for everyone.

🛠️ Infinite Build Possibilities
After each run, use collected materials to purchase new heroes and unlock talents in the shop, making your heroes progressively stronger. During combat, choose from hundreds of randomly appearing items, weapons, and skills. Stack critical chance for extreme damage or build defense to become the ultimate tank? Your build determines your survival!

📦 Vast Arsenal of Weapons & Items
Wield everything from melee swords to the ranged "Buddha's Palm," from fantasy bows to modern firearms. With over a hundred weapons to choose from and thousands of diverse items, every run is a fresh experience.

🔄 Light Roguelike, Ever-Fresh
Death is a new beginning! While your character dies at the end of a run, the resources you collect will help you progress further in your next adventure. Unlock new characters, weapons, and items to continuously expand your tactical options.

Game Modes

🗺️ Battle Mode
Embark on a challenging adventure! Conquer different levels, facing unique monsters and powerful stage bosses!

🌊 Endless Mode
Test your build's limits and see how many waves you can survive.

⚽ Match Mode
A great place to farm resources! Merge, survive, get stronger... and then go again!

🌌 Worldview
📜 Prologue: The Rift Descends, the Multiverse Collapses

In the distant ancient era, the multiverse flourished like a sprawling World Tree, countless parallel worlds revolving in harmonious order. Then came the catastrophe known to later ages as the Doomsday Calamity—a force from the deepest void tore through the fabric of the cosmos. This rift, named the Dark Rift, forcibly dragged, shattered, and recombined fragments of countless worlds, forging them into a single chaotic realm.

Once-great empires crumbled overnight into ruins teeming with monsters. Mighty imperial armies were torn apart by alien beasts from distant galaxies. The hulking remains of mecha littered the land. The guardians of magical worlds fell one by one in brutal trials of survival, reduced to ash on the wind—their souls forever trapped in this accursed land.

As ancient prophecies whispered among wizards smoldered in the embers of darkness, and as ferocious behemoths clawed their way from the earth of forgotten realms, the final fantasy crystals cast eerie light across radioactive wastelands—a voice, ancient and unwavering, pierced the barriers between dimensions and echoed in the heart of every survivor:

"Only the Tiny Heroes can cross the rift and become the final bulwark of this broken world."

You are one such lone hero, chosen by fate. You were not born into this age of chaos. Instead, when the rift tore through existence, you were drawn by a mysterious force from your own world and cast into this eternal battlefield.

Your strength comes from the fragments of countless worlds. Every hero carries the memories and purpose of a shattered realm. Your choices will decide the ultimate direction of this battle royale—this trial of survival.

⚔️ Hero Chronicles
In the eternal arena of the rift, each chosen Tiny Hero bears a unique destiny and power. They come from broken worlds, carrying their own obsessions and missions, writing their legends upon this chaotic land.

🥊 I. The Path of Fists – Awakened Martial Artists

  • 🥚 Small Egg

Description:
💚 Max HP +5
🧺 Harvest +5
🏃 Move Speed +5%

Combat Style: A survival-focused hero, skilled at agile positioning and dodging attacks while using Harvest to gain more resources.

  • 👊 Boxer

Description:
🥋 Kung Fu weapon damage +15
🌀 Dodge +15%
⚠️ Critical Hit Rate -10%
⚠️ Critical Damage -50%
⚠️ Ranged Damage -10
🎁 Initially carry an Arm Fist

Combat Style: A pure melee burst-damage hero focused on fist techniques. Sacrifices ranged combat and critical potential for high evasion and devastating fist attacks. Perfect for players who enjoy close-quarters combat and the thrill of face-to-face brawling.

  • 🔫 Arms Dealer

Description:
🎯 Critical Hit Rate +20%
📏 Attack Range +100
⚠️ Obtained health attribute -50%
🎁 Carry a Handgun initially
🚫 Cannot equip melee weapons

Combat Style: The ultimate ranged damage dealer, with extreme crit rate and attack range, but very low survivability. He can only use ranged weapons, making him ideal for players who prefer eliminating enemies from a safe distance.

  • 🍜 Epicure

Description:
💚 Max HP +30
🐢 Move Speed -20%

Combat Style: Pure survival hero with massive HP but slower movement. Great for players who prefer staying in the fight and absorbing damage head-on.

  • 😎 Bad Boy

Description:
🗡️ Ninjutsu weapon radius +150
⚡ Attack Speed +50%
⚠️ Dodge -30%
⚠️ Ranged Damage -10
🎁 Carry a Fish Sword initially

Combat Style: High-speed melee damage dealer, sacrificing defense for extreme attack speed and massive range. Ideal for players who love weaving through enemy hordes and chasing attack speed.

  • 🃏 Lucky Joker

Description:
🍀 Luck +100
✨ Luck Buff +25%
⚠️ +50% XP required to level up
⚠️ All Damage -50%
💰 When picking up coins, there is a 50% chance of randomly dealing 1 damage to 1 enemy (the higher the luck value, the higher the damage)

Combat Style: Luck decides everything! Despite low base damage and slower leveling, high luck makes every gold pickup a potential killing blow. Great for players who enjoy gambling and surprises.

  • 🎵 Musician

Description:
🎵 All Damage +40%
⚠️ Number of Enemies +50%

Combat Style: High risk, high reward. Gains immense all-damage bonuses but faces many more enemies. Ideal for players who crave maximum damage output and love taking on hordes alone.

  • 🧬 Mutant

Description:
📚 Gain experience +200%
💰 Shop item selling price +50%

Combat Style: A growth hero with extremely fast leveling, but higher shop prices. Perfect for players who want to outpace enemies through levels.

  • 🗡️ Adventurer

Description:
⚡ Attack Speed +200
💪 +100% for all damage attributes
🚫 Only one weapon can be equipped at a time

Combat Style: The ultimate single-weapon specialist. Bets everything on one blade, sacrificing weapon diversity for terrifying attack speed and damage. Ideal for players who love minimalism and maximum efficiency.

  • 💀 Lonely Man

Description:
💀 Move Speed +30
⚠️ Armor -3

Combat Style: High risk, high reward. Extremely fast but fragile. Perfect for players who enjoy high-stakes, high-skill gameplay.

  • 🏴‍☠️ Pirate

Description:
🏴‍☠️ Lifesteal +25% for Holy Weapons
⚠️ Melee Damage -3
⚠️ Ranged Damage -3
🎁 Carry a Scallion initially

Combat Style: A lifesteal sustain hero who relies on Holy weapons to stay in the fight. Lower base damage but strong sustain. Great for players who enjoy brawling and outlasting enemies.

  • 🌾 Scarecrow

Description:
🔥 Elemental Damage +8
⚠️ Ranged Damage -20
⚠️ Melee Damage -20
⚠️ Armor -1
✨ When attacking, there is a 25% chance to deal a scorch damage that lasts for 3s (the scorch spreads to nearby enemies)

Combat Style: A master of flame and elemental control. Despite lower base damage, his burn effects spread quickly through groups, dealing massive sustained damage. Perfect for players who enjoy watching enemies burn like a wildfire.

  • 🛡️ Gladiator

Description:
🛡️ Armor +1
⚔️ Melee Damage +5
🚫 Cannot equip ranged weapons

Combat Style: A pure tank hero with exceptional survivability. Though unable to use ranged weapons, he deals solid melee damage. Perfect for players who prefer standing their ground and fighting head-on.

  • 🐔 Trainee

Description:
⚠️ Number of Enemies +20%
⚠️ Max HP -5
✨ Get an additional 1 reward box at the end of each wave
🎁 Carry a Chicken initially
✨ For every 2 chickens owned, the chicken's bullet ejection count increases by 1

Combat Style: A progression hero. Though his base stats are weak, he grows stronger by collecting more Chickens. Bonus chests help him assemble key weapons faster. Ideal for players who enjoy progression and risk-replayability.

  • 🌻 Gardener

Description:
🌱 All Summoner Attacks +50%
🎁 Carry a Fork initially
✨ Summoners will be generated near each other
⚠️ All item attributes -50%

Combat Style: The core summoner hero. Sacrifices personal stat growth for a powerful army of summons. Great for players who enjoy commanding a horde and leading an army.

👾 Monsters – Calamities from Countless Realms
Monsters pour in like a tide—each a twisted remnant of destroyed worlds:

Monster TypeDescription🧟 InfectedVirus-ridden beings dragging their broken bodies toward you, their eyes filled with hunger for flesh. These creatures from dark abysses have haunted survivors for countless nights. Highly resistant to normal weapons, but flame and elemental attacks are said to burn them away.👹 Demon LegionHellish demons charging through flames with blazing weapons. Their scales are nearly impenetrable—only thunder and divine fists can break through and banish them back to the abyss.🦖 Ancient BehemothsEach moves like a mountain, their roars shaking the very earth. Their skin is as tough as fortress walls—only massive artillery and critical meteor fists can bring them down. Their lairs hide the richest treasures and weapons.🤖 Mech LegionRobot armies from a high-tech world, built from alloy resistant to physical attacks. Electromagnetic and laser weapons are their weakness, piercing their armor and disabling their cores.🌿 Mutant PlantsCreatures from a once-vibrant dreamscape, harmless until disturbed. Their vines can ensnare you instantly, and their seeds fly like bullets. Only fire can drive them back to slumber.

🌟 The Final Hope
As you grow stronger through countless cycles, as your Arm Fist evolves into the Meteor Fist, as your Green Dragon Blade awakens into Green Dragon Crescent Blade, as your electromagnetic gun transforms into the Scientific Electromagnetic Cannon—one day, you will stand atop the world, facing the ultimate threat behind the rift.

On that day, you will no longer be the Tiny Hero struggling to survive among monsters. You will be the savior of all realms, the last hope for every shattered world.

Your legend will be carved into ancient scrolls, told by countless heroes for generations to come.

—This is your destiny, the shared creed of all adventurers. In this fast-paced journey, every choice writes a one-of-a-kind legend, and every death prepares you for the next rebirth.

Take up your weapon—whether it’s the Arm Fist or Green Dragon Blade, whether a handgun or a soccer ball—let it awaken in your hands, evolve into a true divine artifact! 🎮✨

【About the Developer】

I have already released several games on Steam. They are all single-player indie games, maintaining the same characteristics: low barrier to entry, easy to pick up, budget-friendly pricing, and stress-relieving gameplay. They cover various genres including casual, survivor-like, bullet hell, light strategy, survival tower defense, civilization evolution, defense roguelike, and base building. Each game continues the philosophy of being "casual," "easy to learn," and "reasonably priced," with unique gameplay focuses. If you enjoy 2D games with a simple art style and strategy simulation gameplay, feel free to check out the developer homepage and try my other series games in your spare time. I also welcome you to share and recommend them!

Welcome to all strategy game enthusiasts, indie game supporters, and players who enjoy puzzle, building, survival, and Roguelite elements. If you're looking for a time sink and want to enjoy some slow-paced fun in a single-player world, feel free to stop by here for a while.

【Future Plans】

I plan to continue creating more single-player indie games in the future, including inventory management games, martial arts/Wuxia themed games, post-apocalyptic survival (zombie themed) games, management sim games, and even puzzle games~

Thank you once again for your choice. Wish you a pleasant gaming experience!
